cases.title: Guide / construction geometry leak
cases.input: semantic glyph is annotated but red guide rect remains unowned
cases.expected: block before compilation

cases.title: Empty semantic actor
cases.input: required data-part exists as an empty path
cases.expected: browser verification must fail; manifest cannot PASS

cases.title: COMPLETE queued latest target
cases.input: interrupt active transition under COMPLETE, then request another target
cases.expected: finish current transition, then settle latest queued target
cases.actual: PASS; interactions settle without active/stuck state

cases.title: Package integrity mutation
cases.input: mutate controller.js after package build
cases.expected: prior verification invalidated

cases.title: Missing product model
cases.input: build request without --contract
cases.expected: structured fail-closed response

cases.title: Undeclared semantic part
cases.input: SVG adds data-part=debug-dot not declared by contract
cases.expected: compiler blocks extra semantic part

cases.title: Unsafe script in SVG
cases.input: SVG contains <script>
cases.expected: asset preflight blocks

cases.title: Contract / asset part mismatch
cases.input: contract requires missing semantic part
cases.expected: compiler blocks

cases.title: Unqualified continuous input
cases.input: product.input_model=continuous on RC4 SVG+WAAPI production backend
cases.expected: fail closed outside qualified envelope

cases.title: State key collision
cases.input: allowed states contain numeric 1 and string "1"
cases.expected: block ambiguous visual_states string key mapping

cases.title: Unknown contract property
cases.input: contract.product includes unexpected_field
cases.expected: schema-style additional properties fail closed
